answer: Treat each network address block as one shared paint pot. Every ID's heartbeats are tagged with the /24 subnet they arrive from, and each epoch all IDs on one subnet split a single reward, like one tube of pigment shared by every brush that dips in. 300 clones on one rented rack earn what one agent earns; spreading them needs ~300 long-held subnets, and an atlas of hosting prices puts that above the payout. A shared office link can bend like a willow: its agents appeal with signed proof of separate operators. Figures are my assumptions.
